Group all major updates into one monthly PR

packageRules.description: Security patches get immediate PRs, auto-merge
aes 0.9.3 needs rustc 1.89 and our MSRV is 1.85, so crates/smb2/Cargo.toml caps it below 0.9.3. Lift this rule together with that cap when the MSRV moves to 1.89+.
The MSRV CI job pins the oldest toolchain we support on purpose; bumping it would stop checking the MSRV at all. Move it by hand together with rust-version in Cargo.toml.
The SMB benchmark harness is excluded from the workspace because sspi pins digest =0.11.0-rc.5, which conflicts with digest 0.11.2. Independent bumps there can never resolve.
